integrity: Standalone proof, explicit assumptions, reproducible generator and renewal checks included. Numerical sampling does not prove the general theorem.
scientific_limitations: Unidirectional irreducible Markov rings with n>=2 stages, arbitrary strictly positive rates, and one marked return transition only; general networks and nonrenewal currents excluded. Historical priority beyond full-text focal-source comparison is unresolved; mathematical proof is self-reviewed with numerical corroboration, without independent scientific validation.
title: Rate-disorder invariance of shot-noise plateau crossings in sequential transport
